title: [RODEN] Hark, a Book Appears!
content:
Roden Readers —
Howdy! From the sky! En route to NYC! I’m Craig Mod and this is Roden, a newsletter sent via magic tubes.
Since returning from Spain I’ve been in full-bore April Pod Mode, recording a dozen+ interviews and working on a bunch of essays for various publications in service to the forthcoming launch of my new book (did ya hear?) Things Become Other Things. Which, by the way, COMES OUT IN FIVE DAYS.
